item.title: Nomination process to elect BJP National President begins at party headquarters in Delhi
item.description: NEW DELHI: The nomination process for the election of the Bhartiya Janata Party’s new National president began at the BJP headquarters in the presence of Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, Union Home Minister Amit Shah, Union Ministers JP Nadda, and other senior leaders on Monday. item.title: Rahul Gandhi skips court appearance in defamation case, next hearing on February 20

item.title: Rahul Gandhi arrives in Kochi to confer Priyadarshini Award, address Maha Panchayat
item.description: KERALA: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Monday arrived in Kochi to confer the Priyadarshini Literary Award by Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee upon Dr M. Leelavathy in Kalamassery. item.title: 5.7-Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Leh District of Ladakh
item.description: LEH: A moderate earthquake measuring 5.7 on the Richter scale struck Leh district of Ladakh on Monday, causing tremors to be felt in parts of the region. According to the National Center for Seismology (NCS), the earthquake occurred at 11:51 am (IST) and had a focal depth of 171 kilometers, indicating a deep-seated seismic event. [...]

item.description: NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court directed the Election Commission (EC) on Monday to display the names of those on the “logical discrepancies” list at gram panchayat bhavans, block offices of talukas and ward offices in West Bengal. item.title: Unnao rape: Delhi High Court dismisses Sengar’s plea to suspend sentence in death case of survivor’s father
item.description: NEW DELHI: The Delhi High Court on Monday refused to suspend the 10-year sentence awarded to expelled BJP leader Kuldeep Singh Sengar in the case of the death of the Unnao rape survivor’s father while in custody. “No grounds are made out for grant relief. item.title: CBI arrests HPCL sales officer for taking Rs 1 lakh bribe
item.description: NEW DELHI: The CBI has arrested a sales officer of the Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL), Chandrapur in Maharashtra for allegedly taking a bribe of Rs 1 lakh to hand over the company’s retail outlet, officials said on Monday.
